correctness.rationale: Squarefreeness holds exactly c²≠4; genus 3 follows. Hyperelliptic Cartier matrix from coefficients of (x⁸+cx⁴+1)^((p-1)/2) has antidiagonal A and central B; fresh multinomial coefficients give A7=3c,B7=c(c²-1), A11=5-c²,B11=c(c²-3)(c²+1). Stable semilinear rank is 2·1_{A≠0}+1_{B≠0}; elliptic factor is center coordinate, Prym two-dimensional other block by prime-to-p isogeny. Hasse determinant -A²B yields multiplicities, rank<=1 minors in p11 generate (A) since gcd(A,B)=1, and p7 rank-zero minors (c). Direct symbolic matrix tests and inspected extension verifier confirm complete geometric strata, not just finite Fp points.

originality.rationale: The p=11 complete Jacobian strata and identical Hasse divisor were published October 25, 2026. A same-day November 8 published all-odd-prime Legendre-polynomial theorem for the identical genus-three pencil explicitly gives all E/Prym/J p-ranks, a-numbers and superspecial Prym roots. The present p7/p11 tables are specializations of that strictly dominating statement; remaining determinantal-ideal observations follow immediately from antidiagonal matrix and gcd, not a genuinely distinct original final theorem. Publication-order within November 8 is not established, but prior October 25 covers substantial p11 content and full currently published all-prime coverage is decisive for current originality.
residual_risks: Same-day published all-prime result has no verified intraday priority order; current mathematical coverage is nevertheless strong, with older p11 table independently prior.
Scheme-structure remarks are elementary antidiagonal minors, no independently motivated surviving novelty found.
